composition_subtypes.role: DP over prefix, transition uses sliding window minimum

payload.core_composition_summary: DP over prefix i, F[i]=max(F[i-1], F[i-c]+min over last c); sliding window minimum via monotonic queue.
payload.rationale: The solution uses DP to maximize discarded elements; the deque only provides O(1) min for DP transition, not a separate algorithmic mechanism.
